Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.

Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

`--monokernel-backend amd` (the monokernel framework from #44353) needs the [sgl-amd-mono](https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono) plugin, which the ROCm image does not ship, so the option cannot be used with the published images.

## Modifications

- `docker/rocm.Dockerfile`: after the SGLang install, clone sgl-amd-mono at a pinned commit (`SGL_AMD_MONO_REPO`, `SGL_AMD_MONO_COMMIT`), `pip install --no-deps -e .`, and fail the build if its `sglang.srt.plugins` entry point is not registered.
- Installed on gfx950 images only (its kernels target gfx950); `--build-arg ENABLE_SGL_AMD_MONO=0` skips it. The plugin registers its specs lazily, so nothing changes unless a server passes `--monokernel-backend amd`.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A (packaging only).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A (packaging only). The install step was run as written with the image's pip (26.2.1, setuptools 79): the package installs and the entry point check passes on gfx950 and gfx950-rocm724, and the step is skipped on gfx942 and gfx1250-rocm1010.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -434,6 +434,14 @@ ARG FHT_REPO="https://github.com/jeffdaily/fast-hadamard-transform.git"
 ARG FHT_BRANCH="rocm"
 ARG FHT_COMMIT="46efb7d776d38638fc39f3c803eaee3dd7016bd1"
 
+# sgl-amd-mono: the AMD monokernel plugin (--monokernel-backend amd). Pure Python
+# on top of AITER / FlyDSL; it registers its specs lazily, so it is inert unless a
+# server selects the backend. Installed on gfx950 images only (its kernels are
+# gfx950); disable with --build-arg ENABLE_SGL_AMD_MONO=0.
+ARG ENABLE_SGL_AMD_MONO=1
+ARG SGL_AMD_MONO_REPO="https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono.git"
+ARG SGL_AMD_MONO_COMMIT="815b104f483d180027054a8f44bad0c2a3f895fd"
+
 ARG ENABLE_MORI=0
 ARG NIC_BACKEND=none
 
@@ -882,6 +890,18 @@ RUN /bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; \
     git checkout -f "${FHT_COMMIT}"; \
     PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH=${GPU_ARCH_LIST} python setup.py install'
 
+# -----------------------
+# sgl-amd-mono (monokernel plugin; needs the sglang install above)
+RUN /bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; \
+    [ "${ENABLE_SGL_AMD_MONO}" = "1" ] || { echo "[sgl-amd-mono] skip (ENABLE_SGL_AMD_MONO=${ENABLE_SGL_AMD_MONO})"; exit 0; }; \
+    case "${GPU_ARCH}" in gfx950*) ;; *) echo "[sgl-amd-mono] skip (GPU_ARCH=${GPU_ARCH})"; exit 0 ;; esac; \
+    git clone "${SGL_AMD_MONO_REPO}" /sgl-workspace/sgl-amd-mono; \
+    cd /sgl-workspace/sgl-amd-mono; \
+    git checkout -f "${SGL_AMD_MONO_COMMIT}"; \
+    python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --no-deps -e .; \
+    python3 -c "from importlib.metadata import entry_points; \
+assert any(e.name == \"sgl_amd_mono\" for e in entry_points(group=\"sglang.srt.plugins\")), \"sgl-amd-mono plugin not registered\""'
+
 # -----------------------
 # Python tools
 RUN python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir \
